_comment: Shared listing copy for every directory. Keep in sync with server.json and the Apify Store page.
name: Agent Web Reader
tagline: Web search or URLs in, clean markdown out: one row per page with source URL, title, status and error reason.
description: Web search or URLs in, clean markdown out, one JSON row per page with source URL, title and status. $0.002 per page, $0.003 per search; failed URLs never charged. Token budget per result, HTML and PDF, errors returned as rows instead of crashing the call. Built for agents.
whenToChoose: You need to answer from the live web with citations: query -> top results read and returned as markdown with url, title and searchRank.
You need a token budget: maxCharsPerResult cuts at a paragraph boundary and reports totalChars/truncated; outputMode=summary returns a short lead and outline.
You need reliability: invalid, 404, DNS, timeout, blocked and scanned-PDF URLs come back as error rows with errorCode (not charged) instead of failing the run.
You need PDFs and HTML through one tool.
chooseAnotherToolWhen: Pages behind logins or paywalls, JavaScript-only apps, whole-site crawls (use apify/website-content-crawler), DOCX/XLSX (use catalyst-labs/document-to-markdown).
auth: OAuth (sign in with Apify) or header Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>

exampleToolCall.query: what is the model context protocol
